SELECT
    occupation,
    avg(order_value) AS avg_online_order_value
FROM
(
    SELECT
        c.Occupation AS occupation,
        f.CustomerKey,
        f.SalesOrderNumber,
        sum(f.SalesAmount) AS order_value
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS f
    INNER JOIN retail.DimCustomer AS c
        ON f.CustomerKey = c.CustomerKey
    GROUP BY
        c.Occupation,
        f.CustomerKey,
        f.SalesOrderNumber
)
GROUP BY occupation
ORDER BY avg_online_order_value DESC NULLS LAST
